title: Organic Action Plan for England - GOV.UK
text:
Organic Action Plan for England
A 10-year action plan setting out how government and the organic sector will work together to support the growth of organic farming and food production in England.
Applies to England
Documents
Details
The Organic Action Plan for England brings together actions for government and the organic sector to support the sustainable growth of organic production in England.
The plan sets out actions across the short, medium and longer term to help increase opportunities for organic businesses, improve environmental outcomes and strengthen collaboration across the sector.
The plan has been developed with stakeholders through the English Organic Forum and provides a shared framework for delivery over the next 10 years.
